newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Oct 11 foreign reserves at $8.13 bln.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Oct 11 foreign reserves at $8.13 bln.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at $8.13 billion as of October 11, the most recent date for which official figures are available, the central bank said.

It said the figure, which marked an $11.8 million increase over October 4, was the highest since the first week of March and the country's net foreign reserves had increased by $84.3 million since September 7.
Net foreign reserves dropped by $186.1 million, or 2.2 percent, between December 30 of last year and October 11, however, the central bank said.
